name: 4th-Order Finite Difference Gradient
aliases: Grid Normal Computation via 4th-Order Finite Differences
definition: Computes the gradient (normal vector) of a Signed Distance Function (SDF) grid at every voxel center using a 4th-order accurate finite difference scheme. This provides smooth normals for ray marching and shading.
summary: This method computes SDF gradients using 4th-order accuracy at boundaries via extrapolation, avoiding the noise of standard 2nd-order differences.
